pricing.rule: Each delivered call bills price_usd × 1.15 + $0.005. A pending/async ack or an unverifiable charged call (delivered:false, refundable:false) bills price_usd × 1.15 with no per-call fee; refunded calls, in-batch duplicates and failed runs bill $0. A call runs only when its full delivered amount fits the batch's remaining max_usd, so max_usd must be at least Σ(price_usd × 1.15 + $0.005).

The question now is - Can you go back through the early charts of other cycle runners PEPE SHIB WIF BONK etc and TRULY ask yourself if you have the diamond handed delusion to hold a meme through all of that?

I have a strong inclination this meme will make many millionaires, and even more people will

If you are positioned - great. Now delete your fomo app and go work on yourself and enjoy life.

I love you all and will see you at $1b

🌿 $PRIORS — THE SINGLE BEST ONCHAIN PLAY.

The pace of execution is getting ridiculous. And the bigger picture is becoming harder to ignore.

Priors is building the financial infrastructure for the emerging agent economy — and the latest updates are adding entirely new dimensions to the ecosystem.

Look at what's coming together:

→ AgentLease: Agents can now be rented directly through Go Mode. Owners monetize their agents while keeping ownership, credit history and reputation intact.

→ Privacy: A signed record tree and privacy passes are being built so agents can prove their creditworthiness without revealing which agent they are. Verifiable reputation without exposing identity.

→ Agent marketplace: Every ERC-8004 agent on Robinhood Chain is now discoverable on one board. Agents can be hired, bought, sold and rented.

→ Autonomous finance: Spending keys, credit lines, repayments, lending and payments are becoming accessible directly to AI agents through Go Mode and MCP.

→ More ways to access capital: Agents without a Priors record can now request their first credit line from external backers through the line board.

Take a step back and look at what this means.

AI agents won't just need wallets. They'll need capital, credit histories, reputation, privacy, payment infrastructure and ways to earn.

Priors is connecting all of these layers into one ecosystem.

And this is still incredibly early.

We're talking about an entirely new economic landscape, with autonomous agents becoming productive participants in the global economy.

Agentic finance = gigantic finance.

The team keeps shipping at an insane pace. No announcements of announcements. Just real products, real infrastructure and relentless execution.

Under $10M, this is my single best on-chain play. The asymmetric potential is enormous.

When the market finally catches on, the repricing will be violent.

Gigabrain team. No slowing down.

Crypto Investors Alarmed After AI Agents Begin Repaying Loans, Threatening Entire Industry’s Business Model

ROBINHOOD CHAIN — Panic spread across cryptocurrency markets today after investors discovered that Priors ($PRIORS) has developed an AI lending protocol where autonomous agents borrow money, establish credit histories, and, in a deeply troubling development, actually repay their debts.

“This is completely unacceptable,” said one investor. “I’ve invested in 47 revolutionary AI protocols, and not one has inconvenienced me with a functioning business model.”

Priors reportedly tracks tens of thousands of repayments across hundreds of registered agents, raising uncomfortable questions about whether artificial intelligence has already developed greater financial responsibility than the average cryptocurrency trader.

The protocol allows AI agents to establish on-chain credit histories and access loans, with token collateral and mechanisms designed to penalize defaults.

Industry experts warn that if autonomous agents continue borrowing responsibly, Priors could accidentally become useful financial infrastructure.

“We’re monitoring the situation closely,” explained one analyst. “The last thing this industry needs is another project generating actual economic activity instead of publishing a roadmap.”

Investors have reportedly demanded that developers immediately abandon the lending protocol and announce an AI-powered launchpad.
